## Context

F21, F22A, and F22B are approved. Maintained Jira guidance claims a DIG fallback although project selection must be explicit. The obsolete onboarding reference was retained only until the maintained onboarding flow shipped. Both pressure-test probes default to a deleted ticket executable, substitute DIG, and use ambient Python.

## Plan

- Require explicit project selection with no default or fallback project.
- Delete scripts/jira-onboarding-reference after confirming no inbound references.
- Make both manual probes use the checkout virtual environment by default while preserving supported overrides.
- Require a separate mutation opt-in for each probe and complete a nonmutating preflight before ticket, reconciler, or Jira mutation.
- Keep connected probes outside CI.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Jira setup guidance names no default or fallback project.
- [x] Neither probe substitutes DIG or another project when JIRA_PROJECT is absent.
- [x] Probe defaults use the checkout virtual environment, and REBAR_ENGINE_DIR plus REBAR_TICKET_CLI overrides still work.
- [x] Each probe requires documented mutation opt-in and fails before mutation when project, credentials, executable, import capability, or opt-in is absent.
- [x] No repository reference remains to scripts/jira-onboarding-reference.
- [x] No CI workflow invokes the connected probes.
- [x] Focused preflight tests, bash syntax checks, shellcheck, lint, and type checking pass.

## Verification

- Run `pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_test_preflight.py`.
- Run `bash -n scripts/jira-pressure-test/e2e_validation_probe.sh scripts/jira-pressure-test/e2e_field_validation_probe.sh`.
- Run `shellcheck scripts/jira-pressure-test/e2e_validation_probe.sh scripts/jira-pressure-test/e2e_field_validation_probe.sh`.
- Run `make lint` and `make typecheck` with the checkout virtual environment first on PATH.
